purpose: Bounded acceptance contract for feeding one capability result into durable evaluation and optional replanning.

adapter.wiringNote: The harness invokes the production ObjectiveFeedbackReducer and CapabilityResultFeedbackRepository directly. A future daemon route can reuse these assertions without adding a test-only reducer.

requiredEvidence: First feedback submission commits one durable receipt.
An identical retry replays the same receipt without another evaluation.
Exactly one evaluation is linked to the feedback identity.
Same request key and same payload return replay.
Same request key with changed result/evidence returns conflict.
A conflicting retry creates no feedback, evaluation, replan, or attention side effect.
Feedback and evaluation remain readable after reducer/store restart.
Retry after restart replays the original receipt.
The durable identity and evidence cursor do not change across restart.
Accepted feedback carries objective, run, workflow revision/hash, node, attempt, and admission identity.
Evidence references stay within the admitted run and event high-water mark.
Charter revision/hash is preserved and mismatched identity is rejected fail-closed.
A failed evaluation can produce at most one next plan revision for its expected CAS head.
Concurrent/retried replan requests yield one commit and one replay or stale conflict.
A stale plan revision cannot dispatch a second replacement branch.
Missing, stale, or ambiguous result evidence opens attention or remains unknown.
The objective never reports success from an unproven result.
No automated replan occurs without the required durable evidence/authority.

nonClaims: This fixture does not claim provider/model correctness.
This fixture does not claim that an evaluation itself is a human-quality judgement.
This gate must use the production protocol/reducer and durable store once they are available; it must not ship a test-only reducer.
